entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. My order number is VF88-1204.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up order VF88-1204... I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Neither. There was an emergency right after it arrived. I haven't even had time to think about it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright. Can you tell me a bit more about what happened?
My son was scheduled for a sudden deployment, and then right before he left, my husband had to go to the hospital. It required surgery. I haven't had a free moment.

I completely understand, that sounds incredibly stressful. I'm very sorry you had to go through that. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered 16 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.

Okay, I've checked our system. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the date of delivery to make a return. Since it's only been 16 days, you are well within the window. I can process that for you right now.
Oh. Okay, whatever. Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 5 minutes. You'll get a full refund once we receive the item. Is there anything else I can help with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better for you and your family soon.
